findings: Behavioral bug â src/input.js, startInput/parseKeys: terminal data events can split an arrow sequence. If Escape and `[` arrive in one event and `D` in the next, parseKeys drops the first part and maps `D` to `right` instead of `left`. Keep incomplete escape sequences across events before parsing, and add a test that emits a split arrow sequence.

Behavioral bug â `src/index.js:55` calls `run()` on every import. Because `package.json` points `main` at this file and `run` is exported, importing the package starts a loop, reads stdin, writes terminal control sequences, and registers process handlers. Guard the call so it runs only when `src/index.js` is executed directly. Verify that importing the module has no terminal or process side effects and that `npm start` still launches the game.

src/index.js, run/shutdown: Process listeners registered at lines 47â53 remain after shutdown; a later uncaught exception reaches a stale handler while shutdown(1) returns early, potentially reporting failure with exit code 0. Behavioral bug in src/index.js `run()`/`shutdown()`: `run()` registers SIGINT, SIGTERM, and uncaughtException listeners but `shutdown()` never removes them. A focused check found all three listeners still registered after shutdown (counts changed from [0,0,0] to [1,1,1]); a later signal can be swallowed by the finished run, and a later exception is handled by its stale callback. Remove the listeners during shutdown, using a named exception handler, and add a focused cleanup test. `node --test` passed all 7 existing tests.
